title: Monotonicity of the configuration bound
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, and let $n,s,s'$ be natural numbers. If $s\le s'$, then the configuration bound for input length $n$ and space parameter $s$ is at most the configuration bound for input length $n$ and space parameter $s'$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
